candidates.title: Draft a national exam room schedule

demandEvidence.chore: Plan and coordinate national exams by preparing a proposed exam timetable and room booking list from operator-supplied constraints.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Planera, administrera och samordna nationella prov Upprätta provscheman och boka lokaler

ease.reason: The notice names exam planning and room booking, but no attached reference supports school scheduling mechanics or tools.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: schools may value a draft schedule; this paid staff notice does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A synthetic-input timetable mock is possible, but the notice gives no constraints or rules and no attached reference supports scheduling.

autonomy.reason: A mock could format operator-entered constraints, but staff must resolve conflicts, verify rooms and approve all bookings; no automation reference applies.

evidence.reason: The fresh notice explicitly names national exam coordination, schedules and room bookings, but gives no frequency or operating constraints.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded mock that turns fictional operator-supplied exam constraints into a proposed timetable and room list for staff review. The notice establishes the chore, but no attached building reference supports the scheduling mechanics; real deployment would need permission, access and privacy review. The mean is below 6.

rejected.title: School administrator role with broad duties
rejected.reason: The notice describes broad personnel and student administration and proactive support but supplies no specific bounded chore to assess; do not invent duties from the role description.

rejected.title: School administrator role with parallel duties
rejected.reason: The notice says the administrator has several changing parallel tasks but names no concrete task; it cannot support an invented experiment or demandEvidence chore.
